facts.text: Živí se hlavně pakomáry, drobnými mouchami, jepicemi a můrami.
facts.quote: Their main diets consist mainly of non-biting midges and other midges, small flies, mayflies, and moths are regularly found in their diet.

facts.text: Za soumraku vylétá lovit hmyz nad vodou.
facts.quote: The bats emerge at twilight to hunt for insects over the water.
Daubenton's bats can live for up to 22 years.

facts.text: Po hodině lovu může zvýšit svou hmotnost o více než polovinu.
